incidents.name: WSM presale buyWithBNB spot pricing
incidents.notes: The presale contract's buyWithBNB() prices WSM from the BNB/WSM pool spot rate, so a flash loan that skewed the pool let the attacker buy 2.5e24 WSM far below market.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xc0afd0e40bb3dcaebd9451aa5c319b745bf792b4 created 2024-02-08T13:58:57Z by 0x07d993c71bcd38d532a8691fdaa34bdaa815d63b, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x3026c464d3bd6ef0ced0d49e80f171b58176ce32; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). Loss reported by the PoC as 2,517,438,179,912,631,607,253,979 WSM, approximately USD 18K.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xc0afd0e40bb3dcaebd9451aa5c319b745bf792b4 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0xfb071837728455c581f370704b225ac9eabdfa4a, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (4847187s -> 4844110s)
